## Out of scope

**Adding new file types is out of scope of this project**

> Current engine is [online-3d-viewer](https://www.npmjs.com/package/online-3d-viewer) as a fast drop in to handle multiple types.

Thus to get some file type added you can try approaching [upstream](https://github.com/kovacsv/Online3DViewer) (the _engine_ used). If it is implemented there the result would trickle down to this repo.

Anyways, feel free to post ticket here anyways, it can be referenced in the upstream :wink:
